correctness.rationale: Represent a/b as Y=+/-1. The global-memory drift is E[Y_{n+1}|F_n]=qW_n/n, so W_n/A_n is L2-bounded for q>1/2, giving W_n/n^q->L_q. The alternating predictor Z_n converges in L2 and almost surely for q<1 by pairing a summable martingale transform and k^{q-2} drift. S_n-Z_n is a bounded-increment martingale with quadratic variation n-o(n). Conditional martingale FCLT for every finite prefix, followed by L1 approximation of bounded full-history observables, gives the mixing Brownian limit independent of both limiting memory variables. The cross-covariance reduces to a convergent alternating sum with b_k=E[W_k^2]/(k A_k), b1=b2, b_{k+1}<b_k for k>=2; consequently Cov(L_q,Z_inf)<0. The exact recurrence and sign monotonicity were independently checked with rational q=3/5,2/3,4/5,9/10 over 50 terms. The infinite sign follows from the proved recurrence, not the finite partial sums.
